name: Mautic
description: Mautic sends email campaigns, tracks the contacts of your websites and runs marketing workflows. For agencies and marketing teams that want their own marketing platform.
licence_note: Free to self-host, also for commercial use. If you share a changed copy of Mautic, you must share its code.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Open the app at once and finish the installer: the first person who opens it makes the admin account. The cron and worker services send the campaigns and the emails.
